**Finding: deviation (WARRANTY)** — submitted.

- **What exists:** Paragraph 9(b) gives real, continuing Kubient warranties (Service performance to industry standards, services free from utility-affecting errors, no malicious code, compliance with Laws, non-infringement), and the paragraph 13 "as is" disclaimer is expressly subject to "the representations and warranties set forth in this Agreement," so the disclaimer does not swallow them. The services-side duration is Term-long and therefore comfortably clears the 30-day fallback floor.
- **What fails fallback:** no software/deliverable conformance-to-documentation warranty anywhere (the word "documentation" does not appear in the document), and no warranty remedy at all — no repair, replacement, refund or re-performance mechanic exists.
- **Cure (fallback level, one insertion after p0041):** a new subparagraph (xii) adding a 90-day conformance warranty for the Auction Platform and other software, plus a repair/replace/refund remedy at Customer's election for breach of the paragraph 9(b) warranties. Nothing else was touched, and the already-met services duration was not restated.
- Noted in the rationale only (not redlined): the preferred 12-month software period and "professional and workmanlike" formulation.
